title: Corporate Forum
tagline: Full-auth internal discussion forum with admin moderation
description: A role-gated internal discussion platform built with Spring Security and Spring Data JDBC. Employees and managers self-register with access codes, then create threads and nested replies; admins can lock or delete any thread. Runs fully self-contained against an in-memory H2 database.
keyFeatures: Role-gated self-registration via access codes (employee vs. manager)
Threaded discussions with nested replies
Admin-only thread locking and deletion
Session-based authentication with Spring Security
Zero external setup — self-contained in-memory H2 database

title: NovaCore Forum
tagline: HTTPS-secured re-architecture of the corporate forum concept
description: A from-scratch reimplementation of the corporate forum concept, hardened with end-to-end TLS. Employees and admins authenticate over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, and sessions are locked down with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict cookies.
keyFeatures: Full HTTPS with a self-signed PKCS12 keystore
Distinct employee and admin roles
Hardened session cookies (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict)
Admin-gated H2 console access
One-time-use registration access codes

title: Thymeleaf Fragments Showcase
tagline: Modular server-rendered UI built from reusable Thymeleaf fragments
description: A focused demonstration of Thymeleaf's fragment composition model — a single product-listing page assembled at render time from independent head, body, and footer fragments, backed by a seeded in-memory catalog.
keyFeatures: Page composed from independent head/body/footer fragments
Demonstrates Thymeleaf's th:insert / th:replace composition model
Seeded product catalog on startup
No authentication layer — purely a templating-architecture example

title: Role-Based Access Control Demo
tagline: Self-service registration with selectable USER / ADMIN authorities
description: A Spring Security demo where new users choose their own authority at registration time (USER, ADMIN, or both), and an ADMIN-gated products page enforces that choice. Served entirely over HTTPS with automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.
keyFeatures: Registration form with a selectable authority dropdown (USER / ADMIN / BOTH)
ADMIN-gated /secure/products route
HTTPS with automatic HTTP → HTTPS redirect
Authority-based route guarding with Spring Security

title: In-Memory Security Config Demo
tagline: Minimal Spring Security setup with hardcoded in-memory users
description: The simplest possible Spring Security bootstrap: two hardcoded users defined directly in an InMemoryUserDetailsManager, no database at all, used to demonstrate role-based route protection and access-denied handling in isolation.
keyFeatures: Zero-database InMemoryUserDetailsManager configuration
Two roles demonstrated: ROLE_ADMIN and ROLE_USER
Access-denied handling for under-privileged users
Minimal reference implementation of Spring Security route guarding

title: Book Haven
tagline: Thymeleaf client performing full CRUD against a separate REST API
description: A two-service architecture: a Thymeleaf UI client that performs full CRUD on a book catalog purely by calling a separate, independently deployable REST API over HTTP via RestTemplate — no shared database access between the two services.
keyFeatures: Two independently deployable Spring Boot services (UI client + REST API)
Full CRUD — create, read, update, delete — for a book catalog
UI talks to the API purely over HTTP via RestTemplate
Realistic client/server microservice split

title: Linux Network Services Lab
tagline: Core network services configured and validated in virtualized Linux environments
description: Configured and validated FTP, NFS, Samba, and Sendmail services across virtualized Linux environments, with attention to file permissions, service availability, and repeatable administration steps.
keyFeatures: FTP file transfer service configured with scoped user permissions
NFS shared storage mounted and validated across virtual hosts
Samba file sharing configured for cross-platform access
Sendmail mail transfer agent configured and tested end to end
